line.a_jablka.text: The apples are ripe! They hang high up, at the very top of my apple tree. We'll bake an apple pie with them!

line.a_inaczej.text: I'll look at them another way! Hop, I'm standing on my head!

line.a_na_dole.text: Now the apples are down and the grass is up!

line.a_niebo.text: Bunny, up is always where the sky is, and down is where the grass is. Even when you stand on your head.

line.a_rozumiem.text: I see! The sky up, the grass down. Always.

line.a_jak_zdjac.text: But how do we get the apples down? They hang so high, and I can't carry them all at once.

line.a_plan.text: I have an idea! I drew a plan of a lift that will bring the apples down.

line.a_wiatr_plan.text: Oh no! The wind pulled the plan out of my paw and tore it to pieces!

line.a_posklejaj.text: Help us put the plan back together. Move each piece to its place.

line.a_plan_caly.text: The plan is whole again! Look where everything goes.

line.a_plan_gora.text: Point to what is at the very top, on the branch.

line.a_plan_gora_nie.text: Look right up at the top, at the end of the long branch. What hangs there?

line.a_plan_kolo.text: Yes! At the top, on the branch, hangs a wheel. The rope goes over the wheel.

line.a_plan_dol.text: And now point to what is at the very bottom, in the grass.

line.a_plan_dol_nie.text: Look right down at the bottom, in the grass under the rope. What stands there?

line.a_plan_koszyk.text: The basket at the bottom, in the grass! Next to me. The apples will ride down into it.

line.a_zbudowana.text: The lift is ready, just like the plan: the wheel at the top, the basket at the bottom.

line.a_ja_wysle.text: I want to send the basket up! I'll pull the rope!

line.a_kpn.text: Our friend would like to as well. Play rock, paper, scissors. Whoever wins sends the basket up.

line.a_do_gory.text: Send the basket up to the apples. Pull the rope or move the basket.

line.a_ciagne.text: So I pull the rope! Hup, the basket goes up to the apples.

line.a_winda_nie.text: Not here yet. Listen: up or down?

line.a_wkladam.text: I'm putting the apples into the basket!

line.a_na_dol.text: And now bring the basket down to Bunny.

line.a_mam.text: I've got the apples! They came from up to down.

line.a_do_domu.text: We have apples for the pie! Let's go home, through the autumn orchard.

line.b_wiatr.text: How windy! The wind blew everything about.

line.b_sortuj.text: What flies up to the sky? And what falls down to the grass? Drag each thing.

line.nie_tu.text: Does it really go there? Think: does it fly up or fall down?

line.b_dobrze.text: The balloon, the bird and the butterfly fly up. The apple, the stone and the cone fall down!

line.b_dalej.text: The wind is calming down. Let's walk on!

line.b_mapa.text: Look at my map. My cottage is high up, at the very top of the hill. Lead the basket along the path that goes up.

line.b_mapa_nie.text: That path goes down, to the pond. But my cottage is up at the top!

line.b_mapa_ok.text: Up, up the hill! This is the way home.

line.b_do_domu.text: Up we go, home, with the apples!

line.b_skok.text: Let's play! When I say: jump up, you jump up high. Jump up!

line.b_kto.text: Point to who got it wrong and didn't jump up.

line.b_pomylka_wiewiorka.text: Oops, I clapped instead of jumping!

line.b_pomylka_zajac.text: Oops, I clapped instead of jumping!

line.p_start.text: Let's play up and down! I have five games.

line.p_polki.text: Put the jar on the top shelf and the shoe on the bottom one.

line.p_polki_nie.text: Not that shelf. The jar up, the shoe down.

line.p_polki_ok.text: Yes! The jar is on the top shelf and the shoe on the bottom one.

line.p_winda_gora.text: Teddy wants to ride the lift to the very top. Send him up!

line.p_winda_dol.text: And now all the way down!

line.p_winda_nie.text: Not yet. To the very top or to the very bottom?

line.p_winda_ok.text: Teddy rode all the way up and all the way down!

line.p_wyzej.text: Point to the bird that is higher.

line.p_wyzej_nie.text: That one is lower. Higher means closer to the sky.

line.p_wyzej_ok.text: Yes, this bird is higher, closer to the sky.

line.p_wieza_gora.text: Point to what is at the very top of the tower.

line.p_wieza_gora_nie.text: Look at the very top of the tower.

line.p_wieza_gora_ok.text: Yes, Teddy sits at the very top.

line.p_wieza_dol.text: And now point to what is at the very bottom of the tower.

line.p_wieza_dol_nie.text: Look at the very bottom, right by the ground.

line.p_wieza_ok.text: Yes! Teddy at the very top, the box at the very bottom.

line.p_niebo_ziemia.text: What is up in the sky and what is down on the ground? Drag each thing.

line.p_niebo_ok.text: The sun, the star and the bird are up in the sky. The shoe, the mushroom and the stone are down on the ground.

line.d_w_domu.text: We're home! Now we'll bake the apple pie. Oh dear, the wind blew the door open and made a mess!

line.d_na_glowie.text: Hup, I'm standing on my head! Now the hooks are down. I'll hang the shoe on them!

line.d_zawsze.text: Bunny, the hooks are always up, near the ceiling. And the floor is always down. Even when you stand on your head.

line.d_aha.text: I see! The hooks up, the floor down. Always!

line.h_przedpokoj.text: Hang the hat, the scarf and the backpack up on the hooks. Put the shoe and the ball down on the doormat.

line.h_nie_tu.text: Not that place. Up on the hooks, or down on the doormat?

line.h_porzadek.text: Up: the hat, the scarf and the backpack. Down: the shoe and the ball. All tidy!

line.d_jablka.text: And stand the basket of apples at the very top of the shoe rack, on the highest shelf. The ball can't knock it off there.

line.d_jablka_nie.text: That's too low, the ball would knock it off. Stand the basket at the very top of the shoe rack.

line.d_jablka_ok.text: Yes, the basket is on the highest shelf. The apples are safe!

line.d_balonik.text: Look, my balloon from the orchard! Oh no, it slipped out of my paw!

line.d_balonik_wysoko.text: It flew high up. I can't reach it!

line.d_winda.text: I've got my lift here. Send the bucket up to the balloon.

line.d_winda_dol.text: The balloon is in the bucket. Bring it all the way down to Bunny.

line.d_balonik_ok.text: My balloon! It was high up, and now it's down below.

line.d_wyzej.text: Point to what is higher now: the balloon or the basket of apples.

line.d_wyzej_nie.text: The balloon came down. Look at the highest shelf.

line.d_wyzej_ok.text: Yes, the basket of apples is higher than the balloon now.

line.d_szarlotka.text: The apple pie is ready! Made with the apples that came down in the lift from the very top.

line.d_pyszna.text: Mmm, delicious! Good thing the apples didn't stay up there.

line.h_rodzice.text: Play it with your parents: jump up! Hands up to the sky! Hands down to the floor!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping with the apples! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the bird from Squirrel's apple tree. We got it when we learnt what is up and what is down.
